name: Kodak Portra 800
notes: H&D approx from memory of Kodak Portra 800 (E-4051) Status M characteristic curves; straight-line gamma ~0.58 with the Portra family's long soft shoulder and wide underexposure latitude. Layers closely matched (portrait aim), blue a touch lower like the rest of the family. ESTIMATED (not datasheet numbers): spectral crosstalk (Portra family shape with slightly more layer overlap than 400 - faster emulsion, more scatter), DIR matrix (pro-grade, a touch stronger than Portra 400 to hold saturation at speed), halation, orange mask, print paper. Grain: Kodak publishes Print Grain Index rather than RMS for Portra 800; rms_granularity 6.0 is an ESTIMATE placed between Portra 400 (RMS 4) and consumer 800-speed stocks, grain pitch/shadow_bias engine-derived. Grain keys flattened so the engine reads them (nested r/g/b blocks are documentation mirrors). No local Portra 800-labeled scan tuning yet - /mnt/expansion Portra 800 folder exists as a future tuning candidate. 2026-07-11
